entries.camera: Three-quarter close-up from slightly below, 85mm look, shallow depth of field with the face and hood edge in sharp focus.
entries.subject: A young adult human monk, a scout of the Way of Shadow, crouched on the edge of a slate rooftop at night and looking down at a lantern-lit street with calm, watchful concentration. An alert, weathered face marked by a hard childhood on city streets; short messy dark hair under a dark hood; layered grey-black monk's wraps with frayed edges and a few neat patches, linen hand wraps. His eyes catch a faint dull ember glint, as if he sees perfectly in the dark. His shadow on the roof tiles is stretched long and looks subtly separate from him. Far behind and below, the blurred roofs of a harbour town in mist, distant lit windows and a patrol of tiny silhouettes.
entries.accent: cold moonlit blue-grey with a faint ember glint in the eyes

entries.camera: Eye-level medium close-up, 50mm look, the face and upper body sharp, a snowy mountain pass softly blurred behind.
entries.subject: A broad-shouldered female half-orc barbarian, a berserker, mid-battle-cry with her head thrown slightly back and breath steaming in the freezing air. Grey-green skin, small lower tusks, braided dark hair with a few bone beads, fur-trimmed leather and bare strong arms painted with pale ash markings. A huge two-handed greataxe rests on her shoulder, held with one hand. Snow whips across the frame and the low sun rims her silhouette in gold.
entries.accent: icy steel-blue snowstorm with warm amber sunrise rim light

entries.camera: Low three-quarter hero shot from slightly below, 35mm look, the figure filling the left two thirds of the frame, a ruined gatehouse behind.
entries.subject: A male half-orc veteran fighter, a champion, standing relaxed but ready in the broken archway of a stone gatehouse, a heavy two-handed greataxe resting head-down on the flagstones in front of him with both hands folded on its haft. Grey-green skin, strong jaw with short tusks, close-cropped hair going grey at the temples, a calm weathered expression. Worn plate and mail with old soldier's wear, a travel-stained cloak. Late-afternoon sun pours through the arch.
entries.accent: warm sunset bronze and burnished steel

entries.camera: Eye-level frontal medium shot, 50mm look, symmetrical and steady, a rain-dark battlefield camp fading behind.
entries.subject: A female half-orc fighter, a champion, planted in a firm shield-wall stance with a round steel-banded shield raised on her left arm and a longsword held low at her side. Grey-green skin, short tusks, a thick dark braid over one shoulder, a steady, confident gaze straight ahead. Polished but well-used mail and plate, a plain tabard with no markings. Light rain beads on the metal and lantern light warms one side of her face.
entries.accent: cool silver steel with warm lantern gold

entries.camera: Eye-level three-quarter medium shot, 50mm look, an open palm in the foreground slightly out of focus, a dawn monastery courtyard behind.
entries.subject: A young adult human woman, a monk of the Way of the Open Hand, standing barefoot in a stone courtyard at dawn with one open palm extended toward the viewer. A ring of dust and fallen leaves ripples outward from her palm as if pushed by an invisible wave. Short braided dark hair, a calm, focused expression, simple undyed linen wraps and a plain sleeveless robe. Warm light from the rising sun rakes across the courtyard.

entries.camera: Low-angle three-quarter shot from alley level, 35mm look, the figure peeking back over his shoulder toward the viewer, rooftops and hanging lanterns above.
entries.subject: A cheerful, sly male halfling rogue, a thief, crouched behind a stack of barrels in a moonlit alley and glancing back at the viewer with a mischievous half-smile. Curly brown hair, bright quick eyes, dark hooded leather armour with many small pouches, a shortbow slung across his back, a thin set of lockpicks held between two fingers. Strings of paper lanterns glow warmly on the rooftops overhead.
entries.accent: moonlit teal with warm lantern gold
